content.overall_style: gentle watercolor storybook, soft pastel colors, warm lighting, charming classic illustration

character_anchors.appearance_prompt: A large, fluffy cygnet with dusty grey down feathers, a long neck, and gentle, sad dark eyes.

A cold winter landscape with heavy snow falling, a small grey duckling shivering and huddled under a frozen, snow-capped log.
Golden spring sunshine melting thick blue ice on a pond, green grass shoots beginning to grow along the wet banks.
Three majestic, graceful white swans with long elegant necks swimming together on a sparkling, sunlit pond.
The grey duckling swimming timidly toward the three majestic white swans, bowing his head down in shyness.
A reflection in clear, blue water showing a stunningly beautiful white swan with elegant feathers, next to the ripples of the pond.
A beautiful white swan soaring happily into a bright blue spring sky, leaving the sparkling pond below.
